external_entities.name: Players
external_entities.description: Players who run the game client on machines they control.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Players run our game client on their own machines.

external_entities.name: Customer support staff
external_entities.description: Customer support staff who use the moderation website to manage player accounts.
external_entities.source_excerpt: our customer support staff work from the corporate network

processes.name: Game client
processes.description: Player-run game client used to launch and play the game.
processes.source_excerpt: The player launches the client and plays through it.

processes.name: Lobby
processes.description: Lobby service used for matchmaking and match setup.
processes.source_excerpt: The client connects out to two things in our production network. It talks to the lobby on TCP 1234 for matchmaking

processes.name: Game servers
processes.description: Game servers that run matches and update player and match statistics.
processes.source_excerpt: once a match starts it talks directly to the game servers on TCP 1235

processes.name: Moderation website
processes.description: Website used by customer support staff to look at and act on player accounts.
processes.source_excerpt: use a moderation website to look at and act on player accounts

data_stores.source_excerpt: The lobby reads the player database to set up a match

data_stores.name: Stats database
data_stores.source_excerpt: The game servers read and write the stats database during and after a match

assumptions.assumption: The lobby is internet-facing because it must be reachable from wherever a player is and is described as exposed.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the lobby has to be reachable from wherever a player is and is exposed.

assumptions.assumption: The game servers are internet-facing because they must be reachable from wherever a player is and are described as exposed.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the game servers have to be reachable from wherever a player is and are exposed.

assumptions.assumption: The player database is confidential because it contains player account records.
assumptions.basis: The moderation website is used to look at and act on player accounts, and the player database stores those accounts.
